approvals: Pending approval — in-flight approval cards waiting for an admin response. Created by requestApproval() (self-mod install_packages/add_mcp_server) and OneCLI credential approval flow. Rows are deleted after the admin approves/rejects or the request expires.

Verbs:
  list
  get <id>

Run `ncl approvals help <verb>` (or add --help to any command) for flags and examples.

Fields:
  --approval-id                Unique approval identifier (also used as the card questionId).
  --session-id                 Session that requested the approval. Null for OneCLI credential approvals.
  --request-id                 Original request identifier (OneCLI request UUID or same as approval_id).
  --action                     Action type — matches the registered approval handler (e.g. install_packages, add_mcp_server, onecli_credential).
  --payload                    JSON payload carried through to the approval handler.
  --created-at                 Auto-set.
  --agent-group-id             Originating agent group.
  --channel-type               Channel the approval card was delivered on.
  --platform-id                Platform chat ID the card was delivered to.
  --platform-message-id        Platform message ID of the delivered card (for editing on expiry).
  --expires-at                 When this approval expires (OneCLI gateway TTL).
  --status                     Current status. (values: pending | approved | rejected | expired)
  --title                      Card title shown to the admin.
  --options-json               Card button options as JSON array.
